entity_types.CVE_ID: An explicit CVE identifier in the source text, not an ID supplied only as record metadata.
entity_types.VULNERABILITY: A mention of the vulnerability being discussed; do not assume every mentioned CVE refers to the record.
entity_types.SOFTWARE: A software product or component explicitly mentioned in the source.
entity_types.VERSION: A release or version mention, without assuming whether it is affected or fixed.
entity_types.VERSION_RANGE: The original version-range expression. Do not infer unspecified endpoint inclusivity.
entity_types.IMPACT: A security consequence such as denial of service or code execution.
entity_types.REMEDIATION: A patch, update, configuration change or other mitigation mentioned in the source.
entity_types.CWE_ID: An explicit CWE identifier in the source text.
entity_types.SEVERITY: An explicitly stated vulnerability severity or CVSS assessment; not confidence or priority.
entity_types.ACTOR: A person, organization or actor mentioned as reporting or participating in an event.
entity_types.EXPLOITATION_EVENT: A textual mention of exploitation; a possible attack capability alone is not an observed event.

affects.description: The source says a vulnerability affects a product. Preserve denial, uncertainty and conditions as qualifiers.

affected_version.description: The source identifies a version or range as affected. A recommendation to upgrade is not an affected-version claim.

fixed_version.description: The source identifies a version as fixing the issue. Distinguish asserted fixes from recommendations; do not infer this from an affected range endpoint.

has_impact.description: The source connects a vulnerability to a consequence. May/can language denotes a possible consequence, not observed exploitation.

mitigated_by.description: The source connects a vulnerability to a mitigation. Preserve whether it is proposed, conditional or asserted.

classified_as.description: The source explicitly links a vulnerability to a CWE identifier. Do not supply remembered classifications.

has_severity.description: The source assigns severity to a vulnerability. Statement confidence and remediation priority are different concepts.

reports_exploitation.description: The passage reports or denies an exploitation event involving a vulnerability. This records a source claim, not verification or catalogue inclusion.
